subject.title: Feature: Reminders tab in Mission Control

question: Should Mission Control gain a first-class Reminders product surface with a durable typed cron classification and separate visibility policy?
rationale: Source inspection establishes the missing capability, but code evidence cannot choose whether reminders are a distinct core product concept, a generic cron category, or merely a filtered Cron presentation.

options.title: Close Until Sponsored
options.body: Close the request now and reopen it when a maintainer is ready to own the UI, protocol, and visibility contract.

options.title: Sponsor Core Reminders
options.body: Keep or reopen the issue and define an additive typed reminder kind, safe display fields, list filtering, and the dedicated Control UI view.

options.title: Unify With Cron Categories
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/53107 own the shared classification contract, then separately decide whether a Reminders-specific view remains warranted.

recommendation.title: Close Until Sponsored
recommendation.body: Close the request now and reopen it when a maintainer is ready to own the UI, protocol, and visibility contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior follow-up comment and recent adjacent cron history make steipete the strongest available routing candidate for the product-boundary decision.
